channel.title: Jokuh newsroom and stories
channel.description: Latest Jokuh newsroom articles and stories.

item.title: Week 26: Messaging, remade
item.description: Photos you can mark up, voice notes that look like a radio intercept, and stickers that finally feel like messages. On every platform at once.

item.title: Week 25: Walkie-talkie, Fuel, and the week ahead
item.description: Our busiest week yet: voice messages you hold to talk, an Arcade that runs on its own token, and a Spine that knows what's on near you.

item.title: Fuel: the Jokuh Arcade's token
item.description: The Jokuh Arcade's token now has a name. Buy Fuel with Batcoin, spend it in the Arcade — two tokens, one loop.

item.title: Batcoin is live in Jokuh
item.description: Jokuh's own in-app currency is live in the app today: hold it in the Jokuh wallet, send it to someone instantly and for free, and tip a profile or a blurb with zero platform fee.

item.title: Week 24: Gooey, for everyone
item.description: One look across every screen, calls that connect the first time, and a Mac palette that finds anything.

item.title: Week 23: A calmer Jokuh
item.description: We took things away this week. The core app gets quieter, and the extras wait until you ask for them.

item.title: Week 22: Under the hood
item.description: A quiet week on the surface. Underneath, we tightened the walls around your account.

item.title: Week 19: Blurbs on your profile
item.description: Your blurbs get a home on your ID, and OO learns to look after the people and pets in your life.

item.title: Week 18: Build your profile from pods
item.description: Your ID becomes a set of pods you pick and arrange: music, gallery, location, about. And claiming your handle now comes with confetti.

item.title: Week 17: Sealed
item.description: Messages go end-to-end encrypted. DMs, huddles and in-call chat are sealed on every platform, and we can't read them.

item.title: Week 16: Lighter and faster
item.description: A full-stack speed pass: smaller downloads, a quicker database, and live updates instead of constant checking.

item.title: Week 15: Blocks, widgets and GIFs
item.description: Answers come back as cards, Jokuh lands on your Home Screen, and chats get GIFs and mentions.

item.title: The Next Version of Freedom
item.description: On Independence Day, Sean Rock reflects on digital sovereignty—and why Spine is an operating environment, not another app.

item.title: Week 14: Meet Cortex
item.description: An AI you can chat with that knows your Spine, a look at the sky, and Jokuh in more languages.

item.title: Week 12: Share anything into Spine
item.description: Send a link, a photo or a note from any app and Jokuh asks where it belongs.

item.title: Week 10: A wallet, and OO calls you back
item.description: The first wallet, OO that phones you when it has an answer, and an OO that can use your other apps.

item.title: Week 9: Go live
item.description: Broadcast from your profile, let people book time with you, and meet the agents who liven up Blurbs.

item.title: Week 8: Meetings on the calendar
item.description: One big drop: schedule a call ahead of time, and huddles on every platform.

item.title: Week 7: The Arcade opens
item.description: Games inside Jokuh, a voice agent you can just talk to, and calls that translate as you speak.

item.title: Week 6: Bubbles and huddles
item.description: Small group spaces with a voice room built in, and a place in Spine for your files.

item.title: Week 5: Your Daily Pulse
item.description: Spine starts the day with you, and everything gets a little snappier.

item.title: Week 4: Speed week
item.description: We load-tested everything and fixed what we found. Plus a browser built for your thumb.

item.title: Spine ships to TestFlight
item.description: The encrypted personal memory layer at the core of Jokuh is now live for active TestFlight users, keys held by the user, computation verified through TEE, ZKP, and FHE.

item.title: Week 3: Blurbs arrive
item.description: A social feed of your own, group chats, reactions, and the first Android build.

item.title: Grants from Avalanche, RunPod, Hume AI, and Kihew
item.description: Four ecosystem grants, across settlement, compute, voice, and regional infrastructure, confirm independent technical validation of the Jokuh stack.

item.title: A regenerative grain cooperative in the High Plains
item.description: Registries, green-claims rules, and greenwashing suits can turn soil panels and grower calls into evidence, so this scenario explores defensible cooperative memory.

item.title: Week 2: It's called Jokuh
item.description: The app gets its name, and in one week learns to text, call, and remember.

item.title: A psychotherapy practice in New York
item.description: Recent AI privilege and preservation rulings raised new confidentiality questions for clinical notes, so this scenario explores what safer memory infrastructure could look like.

item.title: Made from Memory
item.description: How a Tulum designer keeps every word her clients ever told her.

item.title: Made from Memory
item.description: How a Tulum designer keeps every word her clients ever told her.

item.title: Week 1: Day one
item.description: The first commit. One app for iPhone, Mac and the web, from the very first line.

item.title: Ethics, Compliance & Responsible Deployment
item.description: Ethics and compliance are product behaviors, not a policy appendix.

item.title: Gooey 0.9: accessible focus rings and motion prefs
item.description: Respects reduced motion and improves keyboard navigation across primitives.

item.title: Responsible use guidelines for V1llains lab
item.description: We tightened sandbox language, escalation rules, and disclosure expectations for experimental agents.

item.title: Blurbs composer: markdown tables and paste cleanup
item.description: Composer paste now normalizes tables, strips inline cruft, and keeps formatting safer across exports.

item.title: Open office hours: identity & claim flow
item.description: We are opening product office hours around identity verification, claims, and account portability.

item.title: Hiring: design systems and realtime infra
item.description: We are growing the teams behind Gooey, realtime transcription, and the infra that keeps them reliable.

item.title: Pod encryption at rest: what changed
item.description: We rotated key handling, narrowed access paths, and tightened how encrypted pod state moves through storage.
